name: Glance
thesis: Selling parts should feel like checking your phone.

pages.index.html: Home screen — video Earth backdrop under a bento deck of live widgets with ticking LIVE! offer countdown
pages.market.html: Browse as app grid + listing widget rows with working search filter and a NOW! drop capsule
pages.listing.html: Part as widget stack — giant price numeral, live-activity capsule, 2-step confirm sheet
pages.car.html: Public car profile as a home screen for one machine — hero car tile, live watchers capsule, giant-numeral stats, follow toggle, for-sale app tiles
pages.alerts.html: Notification center as commerce surface — inline accept/counter with state change, dismissals

showpiece: Index home-screen deck: drifting orbital Earth video under spring-staggered live widgets with a working LIVE! countdown capsule
